ui_bugs.issue: Tapping Save Company Info silently no-ops (fires Alert.alert('Invalid phone', ...) that most users may dismiss without reading) when the tenant's stored company phone is <6 digits. On React Native for Web these Alerts are routed to window.confirm and can be missed. The frontend enforces 6-15 digits but the backend accepted a shorter phone in the past (existing testuiowner tenant had phone='9999'), so any owner who never touched Company Info is blocked from saving Membership Tiers or brand changes. Reference: /app/frontend/app/manage/salon-settings.tsx:164-168. Fix suggestion: relax the front-end minimum to allow empty/legacy short numbers (e.g. only validate if length > 0 && length < 6, still show alert but auto-scroll to the phone field), or add server-side normalization on signup to require ≥6 digits.

action_items: Consider softening the phone validation in salon-settings.tsx saveCompany() so users aren't silently blocked when the stored tenant.phone was previously accepted with <6 digits (see ui_bugs above). At minimum, on validation failure, scroll the Company Phone field into view and focus it so the user knows why Save didn't fire.
Optional: on frontend Alert.alert paths, replace with an inline error banner (RN Web routes Alert.alert to window.confirm which is easy to miss).

Optional: promote the DEFAULT_MEMBER_TIERS seed (regular/student/vip) so brand-new tenants immediately have the 3 tiers without an admin having to save Company Info first (currently the frontend fabricates default tiers on-the-fly which is fine, but persistence requires a save).
critical_code_review_comments: salon-settings.tsx saveCompany() validates phone before submitting the entire payload (including member_tiers). If validation fails, tier edits are lost silently — consider decoupling tier CRUD into its own PUT (e.g. small 'Save Tiers' button on the Membership Tiers card) so tier edits aren't dependent on unrelated Company Info validity.

routes/tenants.py PUT /tenants/me accepts arbitrary member_tiers array without validating tier item shape ({id, name, discount_pct, min_price}). Malformed items would silently break resolve_member_discount. Add a Pydantic sub-model for MemberTier.

rca_of_issue: One intermittent issue was investigated during frontend testing: 'Save Company Info' click never triggered a PUT /api/tenants/me despite the button being visible+enabled. Root cause: saveCompany() validates companyPhone as 6-15 digits (salon-settings.tsx:164-168) and returns early on failure. The pre-existing test tenant had tenant.phone='9999' (from an earlier iteration), which failed the validation. The resulting Alert.alert became a browser confirm dialog auto-dismissed by Playwright. Mitigation applied: normalized the tenant phone to a valid 10-digit number via API. Recommended long-term fix is in action_items above.
